sources: Kiel Cardio Database v1.0.0 (PhysioNet, CC BY-SA 4.0)

beats_averaged.note: formula: count of R-peaks found by scipy.signal.find_peaks on the channel with the clearest QRS (largest 99.5th-percentile/median |B| = 45.2), polarity -, height > 0.5 x 99.9th percentile, spacing >= 0.4 s, beats fully inside the 60 s window; inputs: recorded/opm_heart_kiel.json; median R-R interval 1.282 s

r_peak_pT.note: formula: mean over the 47 beats of B at each R-peak sample; inputs: recorded/opm_heart_kiel.json, nv_heart_derived.averaged_beat.beats_averaged. Earth recording with QuSpin QZFM Gen 1 OPMs at the Kiel array position; a different person and geometry from the NV studies.

q_wave_pT.note: formula: SpinDrift rule on the averaged beat, polarity set so R is positive: Q = minimum 10-80 ms before R, S = minimum 10-80 ms after R; the Kiel database has no annotations, so this is not a clinical reading; Q at 25.0 ms before R; QRS 105.0 ms; inputs: recorded/opm_heart_kiel.json, nv_heart_derived.averaged_beat

noise_density.source: Omar et al., 'Human Cardiac Measurements with Diamond Magnetometers', arXiv 2601.18843v1 (Jan 2026), https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.18843 (Table 2, p. 15)
noise_density.note: upgraded from TO_CONFIRM on 2026-11-15: Table 2; averaged between 20 and 30 Hz (p. 4)

single_beat_noise_pT.note: formula: single_beat_noise = eta * sqrt(BW); inputs: specs.nv.jgu.sensitivity, specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed

averaged_noise_pT.note: formula: averaged_noise = eta * sqrt(BW) / sqrt(N); inputs: specs.nv.jgu.sensitivity, specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed, specs.nv.jgu.beats_averaged

single_beat_snr.note: formula: single_beat_snr = A / single_beat_noise; inputs: specs.nv.headline.r_peak_average, specs.nv.jgu.sensitivity, specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed

averaged_snr.note: formula: averaged_snr = A / averaged_noise; inputs: specs.nv.headline.r_peak_average, specs.nv.jgu.sensitivity, specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed, specs.nv.jgu.beats_averaged

averaged_snr_measured_peak.note: formula: averaged_snr_measured_peak = |measured Kiel R-peak| / averaged_noise; inputs: nv_heart_derived.averaged_beat.r_peak_pT, specs.nv.jgu.sensitivity, specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed, specs.nv.jgu.beats_averaged; uses the OPM-measured R-peak instead of the paper's 25 pT

averaged_snr_q_wave.note: formula: averaged_snr_q_wave = |measured Kiel Q wave| / averaged_noise; inputs: nv_heart_derived.averaged_beat.q_wave_pT, specs.nv.jgu.sensitivity, specs.nv.headline.bandwidth_assumed, specs.nv.jgu.beats_averaged; can this build resolve the Q wave after averaging? (>1 means above its averaged noise)
